quest.title: An Adeptal Summons
quest.description: Atop Mt. Aocang, you find traces of an adeptus...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x3, Guide to Diligence x3

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: These are indeed the blueprints for my Dwelling in the Clouds. One is most pleased.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You still haven't said what you're gonna—

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Must you continue to question me? *sigh* Very well, considering you did make an offering...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One has heard of a certain Jade Chamber that hangs in the air above Liyue, built by mortal hands.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: One has also heard that mortals value size above all else, and have on this basis proceeded to declare that said chamber is without parallel in all the world.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Hmph! Such are the limits of mortal comprehension, that they fail to fathom the ingenuity of the adepti.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Jade Chamber my foot! A glimpse at the most trivial of my mechanical accomplishments would reveal the Jade Chamber to be an utterly tedious and mundane piece of work...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sore loser much...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Nonsense! I am no loser, nor am I afflicted with sores... I merely pity the foolish! These mortals, blind to adepti ingenuity, bedazzled by the crudest of craftsmanship...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: I fear that this will cause mechanics among mortals to develop in a woefully mistaken direction. It falls to me to point them down the right path.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: The matter at hand is concluded. Leave at once.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: State your business at once! One has a myriad matters to which one must attend. Waste not the valuable time of an adeptus!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just wanted to see how you're doing...

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Your business is a novel one... You simply came to wish me well, and not to fulfill a wish of some other nature?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Very well, so be it! Mortal minds work in mysterious ways... I have no interest in attempting to understand them.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Since you are so demonstrably idle at present... Would you care to do me a small favor?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Once upon a time, when I had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, I built for myself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: This Dwelling in the Clouds was built principally from plaustrite, supported by a multitude of other ingenious features... In fact, its most marvelous feature of all was, was... Never mind, you would not understand even if I explained it.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: After construction of the Dwelling in the Clouds was complete, I left the blueprints there.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: I also added a seal, thinking that one of true affinity with the blueprints might eventually obtain them. But no — to this day, the seal stands.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: It now seems a needless bother to me to have the blueprints stored there. Perhaps you can retrieve them from the Dwelling in the Clouds for me.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Such enthusiasm. Then do not delay, deliver them to my abode when you have found them, for that is where I shall be waiting for you.

choices.text: What are you gonna do with it?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Naturally, I have my reasons. But please, do not presume that you could scrutinize an idea conceived in the mind of an adeptus.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer
response.text: Delay no further. Deliver them to my abode when you have found them, for that is where I shall be waiting for you.

talks.objective: Go to the adeptus' abode and search for the blueprints
Give the blueprints to Cloud Retainer

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: I see you have obtained the blueprints. Now, hand them to me forthwith!

talks.objective: Place the blueprints before Cloud Retainer

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: You still have not obtained the blueprints? But they are right there, in the Dwelling in the Clouds...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, how'd she know we hadn't fetched them yet?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer
dialogues.text: Those blueprints are a work of my own hand, should I not be able to sense when they are in my presence? Now, fetch them forthwith!

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
dialogues.text: To seek the adepti in Jueyun is no mean feat. Still, you have come forth...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! D—Didn't she already go to Liyue Harbor? Did she sneak back here while we weren't looking?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Her voice... doesn't sound quite right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, so, we were just worried that someone might steal stuff from your place. We didn't mean to disturb you.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
dialogues.text: ...One has a task you might perform. Perform it well, and access to one's abode shall be granted.

choices.text: She's just talking to herself at this point...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Err, so you mean that this isn't her we're talking to, but some sorta machine she left behind?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: Once upon a time, when one had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, one built for oneself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: And when said Dwelling was completed, one thought upon the rarity of meeting an adeptus, and there one left the blueprint, for some fated person to take them.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: Retrieve the blueprint before entering one's abode once more. We shall speak more at that time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Err, Lady Adeptus?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cloud Retainer? Xian... Err, Ms. Xianyun...?

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: Retrieve the blueprint to complete this task, and then one's abode once more. We shall speak more at that time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: On and on she goes, without paying attention to us at all, huh?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But aren't abode machine guards usually the... punchier sort?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, why don't we go get it and then come back and look inside the abode?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's kinda curious about what machine she's left in there, too.

choices.text: I'm a bit concerned about that blueprint...
It's started to repeat the last line...
Could the voice be coming from some sort of device...?

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
dialogues.text: Once upon a time, when one had made a modest breakthrough in my mechanical studies, one built for oneself a Dwelling in the Clouds suspended in the air.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
dialogues.text: And when said Dwelling was completed, one thought upon the rarity of meeting an adeptus, and there one left the blueprint, for some fated person to take them.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
dialogues.text: Retrieve the blueprint before entering one's abode once more. We shall speak more at that time.

dialogues.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
dialogues.text: The blueprints you have retrieved, adeptal fate you have received. Come hither and seek your audience.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Errr, what is this? It's a table... and a box on top of it, and nothing else anywhere!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: You have reached this place, and one knows already your heart...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, it's talking again!

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: Pen down your wish, and consign it to the chest. One shall make the final decision.

response.speaker: Cloud Retainer...?
response.text: Dangers you have braved with an unwavering will — a rare gift indeed. Take, then, these treasures with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Woohoo! Hehe, Paimon knew you wouldn't let us come away empty-handed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Still, this voice says, "Pen down your wish, and consign it to the chest." Guess we just write our wish down and put it in?

choices.text: Best not to make a wish to the adepti willy-nilly...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's right. We could just go to... Ms. Xianyun directly if something came up, hehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, let's just put the blueprint in and leave, shall we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This place sure is empty, though. Guess she must've taken everything with her.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What sort of situation were these devices made for, anyway...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't know either...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we can just ask her about her abode the next time we meet.

choices.text: Making a wish to someone you know feels a bit...
